model.information: research yields only noisy binary signal; paid product choices/declines and fulfillment outcomes observed after operating action and costs; the specific outside alternative is never exposed to the policy; no knowledge of hidden world in continuation choice
limitations: Authored priors and utility/budget personas, not empirical demand or buyer consent
Founder premium is independent willingness-to-pay sensitivity, not validated demand
Finite known scenarios omit acquisition uncertainty, market competition dynamics and unknown unknowns
Expected policy may lose money in realized worlds; robust policy may select nonentry
Gap zero is exact only for this finite action/scenario model, not real-world or game-theoretic global optimality
model.liquidity: All fixed cash costs preflighted; each sequential order requires price plus full order cash expense plus $0.20 native collateral; no within-quarter forecast sales spent; accepted price less 1% residual available after 30-day maturity
model.open_core: Explicit zero-price outside option with the same complete ordinary outcome and setup effort as the competent free incumbent. Paid products do not uniquely unlock the ordinary outcome. Free redistribution rights are hypothetical for simulation; actual repository licensing remains unresolved, and no real open-source license is asserted or granted.
model.profit_objective: accepted revenue minus cash costs minus noncash founder opportunity cost
